methodology.wall_clock: resident forecast: Rust Instant, GPU synchronized/read back; CLI: child process lifetime via wait4 wrapper
methodology.rss: wait4 peak process RSS; device allocation counters are separate and must not be blindly added
methodology.cache: OS file and driver caches retained; fresh process is not a disk-cache-cold run
methodology.default_behavior: F32, symmetric averaging and nonnegative clipping; without_symmetry is the explicit control
methodology.load: all jobs sequential; no sampled Rust compiler/linker overlaps; another model upload existed in this container, so this is not an exclusive host benchmark

excluded_local_sources.reason: compilation restarted during later samples; use remote run for conclusions

limits: Synthetic latency/capacity workloads, not dataset forecast-quality evaluation
No official Oracle intermediate-checkpoint comparison on NAVI31 in this performance run
Maximum context has one warm and one CLI sample per backend, not a latency distribution
No concurrent request throughput or kernel-level GPU profiling
CPU/GPU hybrid entry: scaling, patch/head projection and postprocessing remain CPU
